number: 第二百四十八条の四の六
heading_en: Reports to the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency
summary_ja: SA―CVA採用最終指定親会社は、毎月、CVAリスク相当額を金融庁長官に報告する。
summary_en: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the SA-CVA reports its CVA risk equivalent amount to the Commissioner monthly.
paragraphs: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the SA-CVA shall report the CVA risk equivalent amount to the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency every month.
